cds.title: IUP Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; page headers still read 2024-2025, data are fall 2025)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025 entering class; applicants = male 2,755 + female 5,196). International first-years: 113 applied, 111 admitted (98%), 8 enrolled, so IUP admitted almost every international applicant. Open to nearly all applicants (91% overall admit rate). SAT/ACT optional (C8A). SAT percentiles are for the 25% (460) of enrolled first-years who submitted; ACT figures come from only 11 students and are unreliable. GPA distribution is the all-enrolled column of C11. Undergraduate enrollment 7,425 is the CDS B1 total; 59 nonresident degree-seeking undergraduates is CDS B2 (135 counting non-degree-seeking). The CDS PDF text is jumbled in places; values were cross-checked by sums (residency totals match C1).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A: SAT/ACT not required for admission, but considered if submitted; C8F says 'We are test optional at this time.'

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5/H6 as printed: first-year tuition $7,994 in-state, $11,592 out-of-state, $19,842 nonresident; fees $3,730; food and housing $13,350; books $1,100; other_usd = transportation $500 + other $1,580. These CDS tuition figures are lower than IUP's current 2026-27 billing page, which is used for the cost figures. CDS H6: 32 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid averaging $2,198 (total $70,336); non-need-based institutional aid is ticked as available.
